cases.title: Source-backed ordinary bestiary creature
cases.subject: Sাপcrawl Varnet
source_facts: CR 1 Small Beast (Insectoid), Unaligned
AC 13, HP 14, speed 30 ft. and climb 20 ft.
Poison resistance, tremorsense 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft.
Phosphorescent Trails and Swarm Instinct traits
Bite action
Behavior describes a nocturnal sap-feeder with bioluminescent mating/nesting behavior
acceptance: Combat statistics and Behavior are both inspectable without flattening Behavior into notes.
A linked swarm/group behavior can be presented without changing the creature's source identity.
Source coordinate/provenance is visible to an authorized diagnostic role.

cases.title: Source-backed mobility and reaction creature
cases.subject: Mossling Glider
source_facts: CR 1 Tiny Beast
land, climb, and glide movement modes
Tail Flares reaction
Canopy Dancer trait
Scratch and Bolt action
Behavior describes clever alert alarm signaling
acceptance: Multiple movement modes are readable and noncolor-coded.
Reaction is distinguishable from ordinary actions.
Compact/mobile presentation preserves movement, reaction availability, and behavior context.

cases.title: Source-backed type/affinity modifier
cases.subject: Fire-Type Animals
source_facts: Fire resistance
possible cold vulnerability
fire abilities
hot-environment adaptation
appearance changes
acceptance: Modifier is presented as an applies-to relationship rather than silently replacing base identity.
Resistance, possible vulnerability, abilities, environmental adaptation, and appearance can be compared as field effects.
The word 'may' remains conditional rather than being converted into a guaranteed source fact.

cases.title: Source-backed age/power stage chain
cases.subject: Dragon age and power stages
source_facts: Hatchling/Wyrmling, Juvenile, Adult, Elder, Ancient are listed as possible age stages
Greatwyrm is Chromatic-only
not all dragon types follow the same stage model
Reptilian, Bird-Dragon, Chromatic, Arcane-Born, and Exo intelligence patterns differ
acceptance: Stage chain preserves category-specific exceptions instead of forcing one universal ladder.
Variant comparison does not imply every stage exists for every dragon category.
Known stage siblings are traversable without display-name identity matching.

cases.title: Source-backed sentience spectrum
cases.subject: Dragon intelligence spectrum
source_facts: Reptilian Dragons are described as animalistic (INT 2-5)
Bird-Dragons as semi-sapient (INT 6-9)
Chromatic Dragons as sapient (INT 10-16)
Arcane-Born as highly intelligent (INT 14-26)
Exo Dragons may have divine-class intellect
acceptance: Presentation can foreground both creature mechanics and persona/social information where relevant.
Intelligence/sapience source wording does not automatically grant Campaign relationships, motives, or faction memberships not present in source/Campaign data.

cases.title: Source-backed playable creature conversion
cases.subject: Monster-to-playable-species procedure
source_facts: start from the lowest-CR version
retain inherent physical traits such as size, movement, natural armor/senses/weapons
base XP cost uses CR x 500 XP with a source-stated limited-resource discount rule
unique abilities begin locked and can be purchased
HP and defenses are normalized for character play
ability scores are recalculated
multi-tiered abilities can become progression tiers
acceptance: Conversion links source creature to a playable-species/Character workflow without identity equivalence.
Source monster HP/state is not reused as live Character HP.
Conversion provenance identifies retained, normalized, excluded, and unlockable parts.

cases.title: Source-backed Havalaean sapient-animal conversion
cases.subject: Havalaean Sapient Animal Template
source_facts: normal animal can be converted into a sentient speaking culturally aware Havalaean native
creature type can change toward Beast (Sapient) or Beastfolk
Intelligence is raised to a minimum stated by source
language and cultural heritage are added
acceptance: A creature-to-persona conversion can expose social/persona sections without overwriting the base animal source record.
Culture/language additions remain part of the conversion result/provenance rather than retroactive facts about every base animal.

cases.title: Named NPC with hidden motive and visible testimony
acceptance: Player sees identity and revealed statement but not hidden motive/relationship/inventory.
GM sees authorized full persona and can open linked relationship/equipment objects.
Changing to combat/runtime context adds instance state without mutating the reusable NPC Definition.

cases.title: Hidden scene placement and reinforcement
acceptance: Unauthorized Player projection contains no existence, count, wave, tactic, search suggestion, facet contribution, relationship count, or compare target before reveal.
GM projection preserves source stable ID plus distinct placement/instance IDs.
Reveal changes future authorized projection through the owning workflow; it is not a client-side unhide of already delivered secret data.

cases.title: Summon/minion lifecycle and controller
acceptance: Master/source relationship is visible only where authorized.
Summoned instance lifecycle does not mutate the summoned Definition.
Controller, owner, summoner, and source creator are not collapsed into one role.

cases.title: Swarm/group projection
fixture_requirements: group definition or governed grouping relationship
acceptance: Group-level mechanics do not erase member source identities.
Authorized UI distinguishes group quantity/scale from hidden encounter placement count.
Keyboard/screen-reader path can traverse group/member relationships nonvisually.

cases.title: Incomplete or conflicted Creature/NPC source record
acceptance: Inspector remains usable without fabricating missing fields.
Source fact, recommendation, conflict, and unresolved state are distinguishable.
Compare never silently selects a winning source/version and no same-name auto-merge occurs.
